summary: BP PLC filed Form 6-K reporting director/PDMR shareholdings under Rule 13a-16. The filing covers routine notifications of shares acquired through a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP) by several executives in April 2026. No transactional terms beyond the DRIP price of £5.98324 per share and volumes for each executive are given. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics related to a special situation. This is a standard obligation for foreign private issuers and does not reflect any special corporate event. No special situation risk-arb angle is present.
